summary: A City Council committee approved a proposed 45-day moratorium on new data centers, sending it to the full council.

source.citation: Strisker Data Centers Weekly Briefing, Sept 21-24, 2026 (digest), citing local reporting (NBC Bay Area)

notes: City file 27-0050 on the Oct 6 agenda; covers approval of land use entitlements or agreements for development or operation of data centers; amendment packages from Councilmember Wang (D2) and supplemental legislation dated Sept 24 attached.

next.event: Oakland City Council, File 27-0050: urgency interim ordinance (Gov. Code 65858) moratorium on data center entitlements
